Uppercase and lowercase letters must match exactly. With the word "Spam", the rule won't trigger on "spam" or "SPAM".
Ignore partial matches inside longer words
The rule won't fire if the word is only part of another word. A hyphen counts as part of the word too, so "some-thing" won't match a rule for "thing".
Advanced: treat the pattern as a regex
The pattern is read as a regular expression instead of plain text. For example, "time.?out" catches both "timeout" and "time-out".
Skip text inside links and clip URLs
The rule skips links and clip URLs entirely. This avoids accidental hits: a clip link ending in "-W" won't trigger a rule for "W".

The windows can't be moved or resized by accident. The panel still shows on hover so you can unpin.

Keeps the chat visible over a full-screen game or browser. macOS allows this only for apps without a Dock icon, so by default Chatone leaves the Dock and Cmd+Tab while a screen chat is open. To get back, use the button on the chat panel or the Chatone icon in the menu bar.
